camel_example: aliyun sas PublicPreCheckImageScanTask --region cn-hangzhou --RepoIds 'crr-vridcl40000' --Digests 6a5e103187b31a94592a47a5858617f70000 --SourceIp '192.168.XX.XX' --RegionIds 'cn-hangzhou' --RepoNames centos --InstanceIds 'i-uf6j8vq9l4r5ntht0000' --RegistryTypes acr --RepoNamespaces 'hanghai-namespace' --Tags '0.2'
description_en: Queries the number of images to scan in an image scan task and the quota for container image scan to be consumed by the task
description_zh: 查询容器镜像安全扫描覆盖的镜像数和待消耗的授权数
kebab_example: aliyun sas public-pre-check-image-scan-task --source-ip 192.168.XX.XX --registry-types acr --region-ids cn-hangzhou --instance-ids i-uf6j8vq9l4r5ntht0000 --repo-namespaces hanghai-namespace --repo-ids crr-vridcl40000 --repo-names centos --digests 6a5e103187b31a94592a47a5858617f70000 --tags 0.2 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PublicPreCheckImageScanTask

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The type of the image repository. Separate multiple types with commas (,). Valid values:

acr
harbor
quay
parameters.help_zh:
镜像仓的类型。多个镜像仓的类型之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

acr
harbor
quay
parameters.name: registry_types

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the image. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像的地域ID。多个地域ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: region_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Container Registry instance in which the image repository is created. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: ACR镜像仓实例的ID。多个实例的ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The namespace to which the image repository belongs. Separate multiple namespaces with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像仓的命名空间。多个命名空间之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: repo_namespaces

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image repository. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像仓的ID。多个镜像仓的ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: repo_ids

parameters.help_en: The name of the image repository. Separate multiple names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像仓的名称。多个镜像仓的名称之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: repo_names

parameters.help_en: The SHA-256 value of the image digest. Separate multiple SHA-256 values with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像的摘要的SHA256值。多个摘要的SHA256值之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: digests

parameters.help_en: The tag that is added to the image. Separate multiple tags with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像的标签。多个标签之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: tags

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 接口调用成功时，返回的数据

NeedAuthCount.description_en: The number of images to scan in the task
NeedAuthCount.description_zh: 镜像安全扫描覆盖的镜像的总数量

ScanImageCount.description_en: The quota for container image scan to be consumed by the task
ScanImageCount.description_zh: 镜像安全扫描待消耗的授权数

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
